card.name: The start of "poison" in poison control
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word "poison" (" PO" or ".po") in overdose instructions that mention a poison control center or the poisonhelp web address, right before the "ison" ending.

modes.label: Web address
modes.description: The ".po" start of www.poison.org in a poison control center contact line.
modes.example: call your poison control center at 1-800-222-1222 or www<<.po>>ison.org.

modes.label: Capitalized warning
modes.description: The " PO" start of POISON in an all-caps child-safety and overdose warning.
modes.example: CONTACT A<< PO>>ISON CONTROL CENTER IMMEDIATELY.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the non-"po" continuations, so it works as a signal tied to the "ison" ending that completes "poison".
card.plain: It lights up on the first letters of "poison" when a label tells readers to call poison control.
